title: NBA: Pistons down Magic, Celtics hold off Wizards
summary: The Detroit Pistons shrugged off the injury absence of Cade Cunningham to keep their NBA Cup hopes alive on Tuesday with a gritty 104-86 road victory over the Orlando Magic.
